failure_pattern.common_failure_stage: Reference executable returned nonzero before slice upload

known_harness_constraint.observation: strict_first_sample admits previously qualified fallback only when p%bottom_mode==2. C6M free drainage uses p%bottom_mode==7, so failed first attempts intentionally fail closed.
known_harness_constraint.interpretation: This is consistent with the existing DYN0A numerical-authority boundary. It is not authority to change retry/fallback semantics after seeing C6M response.

diagnostic_authority.purpose: Capture exact executable failure text for one frozen B01 and one frozen B14 slice under unchanged C6M forcing/solver authority.
diagnostic_authority.selection_reason: One case per frozen material at the middle spatial comparator; not used to rescue or retune C6M.

stop_rules: No enabling the fixed-flux-only fallback for free drainage after this failure.
No change to top-flux histories, material set, numerical gate or Reference solver policy.
Diagnostic rerun may only expose existing failure messages and step/revision context.
